anya_dx: Quick report: sampleapp streaming sometimes throws JSON parse error after fast close+reopen. Repro below.
kevin_sdk: can you share raw chunks?
leo_browser: example arrival order when toggling tab: data: {"id":"m1","delta":"Hi"}

data: {"id":"m2","delta":"There"}

data: {"id":"m1","delta":"!","end":true}
We expected m1 then m1 end, then m2. Browser got m2 in middle.
sam_infra: server emitted m1,m1_end,m2. Likely fetch split + resume merged chunks from two sockets.
kevin_sdk: SDK currently concatenates by arrival. Short-term sampleapp patch idea: buffer and only emit complete JSON objects; drop duplicates if identical final event seen within 1s.
anya_dx: ok patch that in sampleapp README and push to quickstart so new users don't hit it.
kevin_sdk: opening SDK ticket to add reassembly layer that looks for "data:" boundaries and last-event-id to avoid misordering.
sam_infra: also add e2e sim that flips network mid-stream.
anya_dx: thanks team, will validate once PRs merge.
